links.note: Modern-Hindi rendering of the pad's body argument -- 'मैं तो छोटा-सा बालक हूँ' is 'मैं बालक बहियन को छोटो', the second of the three तर्क in 32544. 32547 is the exercise that asks which of four statements counts as a तर्क; this item is the line itself.
'मेरी बाँहि छोटी हैं' renders the same body argument, बहियन को छोटो, in 32544. 32557 takes छींका out of that couplet as a household object to name at home; this sentence never mentions the छींका.
'माता तुम मन की बहुत भोली हो' renders 'तू माता मन की अति भोरी', which opens the उलाहना half of the pad in 32545. 32544 holds only the denial and the three तर्क; the reproach is 32545's.

'इन्होंने मक्खन हठपूर्वक मेरे मुख पर लगा दिया' renders 'ग्वाल-बाल सब बैर परे हैं, बरबस मुख लपटायो', the third तर्क in 32544 -- हठपूर्वक is बरबस. In 32545 the ग्वाल-बाल appear only as the people his mother believed.
Synonyms for गाय. The pad's only cow is 'भोर भयो गैयन के पाछे', the time argument in 32544. 32560's चार पहर arithmetic is about hours, not the animal.
Synonyms for माँ, keyed as माता, मातु, जननी. The surface form माता occurs in 'तू माता मन की अति भोरी', which is 32545; 32544 addresses her as मैया in the refrain, not as माता.

Synonyms for सखा -- साथी, मित्र, संगी. The pad's only companions are the ग्वाल-बाल whose बैर is Krishna's third तर्क in 32544. 32562's सहपाठी situations are the student's own classmates, not the pad's.
Synonyms for संदेह -- शंका, संशय. The pad's suspicion is 'जिय तेरे कछु भेद उपजि है, जानि परायो जायो', in 32545. 32544 contains no doubt at all, only the इनकार and the three arguments.
Synonyms for मुख. मुख occurs once, in 'बरबस मुख लपटायो' -- the butter smeared on his face, the third तर्क in 32544. 32545's body words are लकुटि and कमरिया.
Antonym of छोटा. छोटो is the pad's word in 'मैं बालक बहियन को छोटो', the body argument in 32544. 32561's 'हम सब विशेष हैं' is about सूरदास being दृष्टिबाधित, not about smallness.
Antonym of पराया. परायो occurs exactly once, in 'जानि परायो जायो' -- the charge that his mother treats him as someone else's child -- which 32545 covers. Nothing in 32544 uses the word.
Antonym of बैर. बैर occurs in 'ग्वाल-बाल सब बैर परे हैं', the third तर्क in 32544. 32545's cowherd boys are only the ones whose word his mother took, with no बैर in that line.

Antonym of हँसना. The pad laughs once, in its last line -- 'सूरदास तब बिहँसि जसोदा, लै उर कंठ लगायो' -- which closes 32545. 32550 asks WHY यशोदा laughed; the word itself comes from that closing couplet.
What श्रीकृष्ण said to माता यशोदा -- that he did not eat the माखन, the इनकार that opens 32544. 32545 is what he says after the arguments, the उलाहना, not the denial.

Where he was sent at daybreak -- मधुबन, from 'भोर भयो गैयन के पाछे, मधुबन मोहि पठायो', the time argument in 32544. 32549 quotes the same line, but as one of the two lines to reflect on, not as a fact to recall.
Where he wandered for चार पहर -- बंसीवट, the second half of the time argument in 32544. 32560's चार पहर exercise converts the pahars into clock hours; this asks the place.

Why he called his mother भोली -- because she believes whatever they say, 'इनके कहे पतियायो', the उलाहना in 32545. 32555 glosses भोरी as भोली as a वर्ण-परिवर्तन point; this item wants the reason, not the form.
What he said about his बाल-ग्वाल सखा -- that they are hostile, 'ग्वाल-बाल सब बैर परे हैं', the third तर्क in 32544. 32545 mentions them only as the source of the charge his mother believed.
Who wants him proved guilty -- the ग्वाल-बाल, again the third तर्क in 32544. 32556 is the 'अपनी बात सिद्ध करना' block, which is about the student's own experience of having to prove innocence.
What he offers to hand back -- लाठी और कंबल, that is 'ये ले अपनी लकुटि कमरिया', the रूठना that 32545 is named for. 32544 has no property in it at all.
What he refuses to do any more -- graze the cows, which is what returning the लकुटि and कमरिया means in 32545's sulk. 32544's cows are in the alibi, where he is still going out with them.

यशोदा's reaction to the arguments -- she smiled and embraced him, stated in 32545's closing couplet 'सूरदास तब बिहँसि जसोदा, लै उर कंठ लगायो'. 32550 asks the inference, why she laughed; this MCQ asks what she did.

Fill-in of 'भोर भयो गैयन के पाछे ___ मोहि पठायो' with मधुबन -- recall of the time argument's line in 32544. 32553 takes पाछे from this same line as a Brajbhasha form, but the blank is the place, not the form.

Fill-in of 'मैं बालक ___ को छोटो' with बहियन -- the body argument in 32544. 32554 asks students to write such Braj words in the form they themselves use; here the pad's own word is what must be recalled.
Fill-in of 'ग्वाल-बाल सब ___ परे हैं' with बैर -- the third तर्क in 32544. 32545's ग्वाल-बाल line, 'इनके कहे पतियायो', contains no बैर to blank out.

Fill-in of 'तू माता मन की अति ___' whose answer is the Braj form भोरी -- exactly the word 32555 exists for (भोरी यानी भोली, the ल-र वर्ण परिवर्तन). 32545 holds the line's sense; this blank tests the old form itself.
Fill-in of 'ये ले अपनी ___ कमरिया, बहुतहिं नाच नचायो' with लकुटि -- the phrase in 32545's own name. 32557's household objects are the छींका and its kind, not the staff and blanket.
True/false that श्रीकृष्ण accepted the theft charge -- असत्य, because the pad opens 'मैया मैं नहिं माखन खायो', the इनकार in 32544. 32556 is the student's own experience of denying something.

True/false that he spent most of the day at बंसीवट -- this is precisely 32548's discriminating point, that what he was doing before his mother came is 'चार पहर बंसीवट भटक्यो' and not eating माखन or playing with friends. 32544 carries the line; 32548 is the concept built on that line being the answer.
True/false that the ग्वाल-बाल behaved as friends -- असत्य, they are बैर, the third तर्क in 32544. 32562's helping-others block is about the student's classmates, not the pad's cowherd boys.
True/false that he was sent to मधुबन at daybreak -- recall of 'भोर भयो... मधुबन मोहि पठायो' in 32544. 32549 sets that line as a reflection task; a सत्य-असत्य is recall of it.

True/false that he said he is too small to reach the छींका -- the body argument's line 'छीको केहि बिधि पायो' in 32544. 32557 lifts छींका out of that couplet as a household object to name at home; this item verifies the claim.

Quotes the pad's first five lines and asks what सफ़ाई श्रीकृष्ण offers -- that is 32544 entire: the इनकार plus the time, body and blame arguments. The काव्यांश stops before 'तू माता मन की अति भोरी', so 32545 is untouched.
Quotes the pad's second half -- भोरी, परायो जायो, लकुटि कमरिया, बिहँसि जसोदा -- and asks what he wants to say: 32545's उलाहना, रूठना and the embrace. 32544's three arguments are not in this काव्यांश.

Asks the student to write about secretly eating something forbidden and then making an excuse -- that is 32556's 'पाठ से आगे, आपकी बात', which asks when you had to prove you had not done something and what तर्क you gave. 32552's कल्पना questions stay inside the pad: why कृष्ण argued, and what happened after the embrace.

Asks what मधुबन and बंसीवट are -- a gloss of two Braj words with no modern equivalent, which is exactly the word-and-meaning matching 32554 sets up. 32544 contains both words in its lines, but it is the argument, not the glossary.
Who 'बहुत नाच नचाया' him and what he tells माता यशोदा -- the लकुटि-कमरिया couplet, 32545's sulk, where he hands both back. 32544 holds the three तर्क; this complaint is the रूठना that follows them.
Who says 'मैया मैं नहिं माखन खायो' to whom -- the pad's opening इनकार, 32544. 32546 identifies the poet सूरदास, but the speaker here is the child कृष्ण.
Where कन्हैया goes at daybreak -- मधुबन, the time argument in 32544. 32548's MCQ asks what he was doing before his mother came, whose answer is बंसीवट, not मधुबन.
Whom he calls his बैरी -- the ग्वाल-बाल, the third तर्क in 32544. 32545 names them only as the ones whose word his mother took.

Asks the कारण he gives for not climbing to the छींका -- the very distinction 32547 is built on: of the four things he says, only the short arms are a तर्क, the rest are उलाहना and रूठना. 32544 states the line; 32547 is the concept about that line being the answer to 'क्या तर्क दिया'.

Quotes the pad's first half; the four sub-questions are who speaks to whom, how he defends himself, how many पहर he grazed and who sent him -- all inside 32544's denial and three arguments. 32545's half is not quoted at all.

Quotes the pad's second half; sub-questions 3 and 4 -- what the लकुटि कमरिया does to him, and the meaning of उर in 'लै उर कंठ लगायो' -- come only from these four lines, which is 32545. The मधुबन and चार पहर sub-questions are answerable from the recited pad but are not what this काव्यांश is.

Quotes the pad's first half and asks why he could not have stolen the माखन (he is a small child), why he was sent to मधुबन, why माखन was on his mouth (the ग्वाल-बाल forced it) and the meaning of बरबस -- the three तर्क of 32544 one by one. This is the chapter's own सूरदास pad, genuine content, not bled-in material.

Quotes the pad's second half; three of its four sub-questions are inside those lines -- the meaning of लकुटि कमरिया, who took him to her breast (यशोदा), पतियायो, and 'मन की अति भोरी' -- which is 32545 end to end. 32546's 'बाल-लीलाओं का वर्णन' answers only the opening sub-question about what the poet describes. This too is the chapter's own सूरदास pad, genuine content.
